headline: Silver Falls 3.8 Percent To $51.42 As Gold Drops 1.07 Percent
narrative: Silver fell 3.8 percent to $51.42, and gold fell 1.07 percent to $4,008.4, so money left the precious-metals pipe. Oil rose 0.63 percent to $103.43, a bid in the energy pipe while the metals gave ground. Bitcoin traded near 77k.
author: jordan
